metadata.industry: Test - Worker→Worker service binding × DO × KV remap × Access policy
metadata.notes: Real-world layering — the entire worker dependency graph in one config. Three workers: (parent) → (rpc-helper) via service binding; (parent) defines a DO class for state; (parent) reads from KV. Then an Access policy protects the parent's hostname. Grounded in: edge case #5 — no topological sort for service bindings (Worker A can fail if B uploads later in the parallel batch); edge case #4 — KV 'already exists' silently broken binding rewrite; edge case #7 — DO namespace creation timing; and a known Workers-O2O quirk where request.cf.tls* fields may be empty on SaaS-side workers (parent worker reads request.cf to exercise that surface). Stacks four assertions: service binding resolves, DO namespace binding created on dest (assertDoNamespaceCreated — namespace creation is automatic when a DO class binding is migrated; DO state copy is a separate opt-in assertion that requires Step 3 driver), Access IdP remapped, KV keys copied.
